# filemanager_groups (Data Source)

Lists all groups on the system. This data source reads from /etc/group on Unix/Linux systems.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter groups by name pattern (supports * wildcard).
- `max_gid` (Number) Maximum GID to include.
- `min_gid` (Number) Minimum GID to include (e.g., 1000 to exclude system groups).

### Read-Only

- `gid_map` (Map of String) Map of GID (as string) to group name for reverse lookup.
- `group_map` (Map of Number) Map of group name to GID for easy lookup.
- `groups` (Attributes List) List of groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `gid` (Number) Group ID.
- `members` (List of String) List of usernames that are members of this group.
- `name` (String) Group name.
